incident-bot: Pagerduty alert: CRITICAL - auth-proxy unusual credential noise detected (INC-2026-423). Paging rw-oncall.

incident-bot: Affected service: ingress-auth-proxy.edge-1. Large spike in auth failures and repeated token reuse patterns. First spike at 2026-03-17T12:07:30Z. Sample offending IPs: 54.12.34.56, 54.12.34.57.

sara (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall — joining. What's the impact?

mike (eng-sre): Seeing repeated "invalid_token" responses at scale, ~7k reqs/min peak. Also a tail of 5xx for upstreams. Started ~12:07. Looks like replay / brute attempts against service tokens.

leo (security): We're also seeing outbound writes to staging-log-bucket.s3 from edge-1 around the same time window. Could be a misconfigured forwarder or exfil.

mike (eng-sre): Pasting a short log snippet:
```
edge-1 auth-proxy [12:08:02] 54.12.34.56 "POST /v1/generate" 401 invalid_token svcacct-id=svc-internal-logger
edge-1 forwarder [12:08:05] PUT https://s3.amazonaws.com/staging-log-bucket/2026-03-17/log.gz 200
```

sara (oncall): I'm going to block the offending IPs at the edge WAF and mute the noisy routes. Applying temporary WAF rule now.

sara (oncall): Command: `curl -X POST https://console.edge/waf/rules -d '{"action":"block","ips":["54.12.34.56","54.12.34.57"]}'` -> response 202.

leo (security): Good. Also please disable the staging log forwarder job to stop potential leakage. If anyone has access to the staging S3 write key, rotate it immediately.

mike (eng-sre): I'm starting rotation for staging write key and the svcacct used by forwarder. Opening rotation ticket: https://redwood/ops/tickets/INC-2026-423-rotations (in progress).

ana (typo message) [deleted]: n/a

ana (product) [not present]: n/a

ana (product): (typo above ignore) Do we have customer impact? Any PII or customer request logs shipped?

mike (eng-sre): Preliminary telemetry: three customers show elevated errors and one has unusual request patterns that match the replay IPs. No confirmed PII in staging bucket metadata yet — still investigating object contents.

leo (security): Tagging @tessa (legal). If logs contain request bodies or API keys, we may need to notify affected customers.

tessa (legal): On it. Please capture scope: list of object keys in staging bucket, prefixes, and timestamps. Also need list of affected customer org IDs.

sara (oncall): Running quick list: `aws s3 ls s3://staging-log-bucket/2026-03-17/ --recursive | head -n 50` -> found ~42 objects 12:07-12:12 UTC. Exporting keys to S3 and will share.

mike (eng-sre): Quick grep indicates object prefixes: `staging/edge-1/auth/2026-03-17/` — pulling first 10 objects for review.

leo (security): For containment: 1) WAF block applied, 2) log-forwarder scaled to 0, 3) staging S3 write key rotated, 4) rotation ticket open, 5) throttle rule applied to auth-proxy. We'll need post-incident forensic review.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: scaledown log-forwarder -> replicas=0 by sara at 2026-03-17T12:22:10Z.

sara (oncall): Confirmed forwarder scaled. Blocked IPs propagated. Rotation started and keys revoked. I've also raised an incident status page: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-2026-423 (status: investigating).

ana (product): Please set expected comms: do we notify customers now or after scope?

tessa (legal): Wait for scope summary + whether any customer keys or request bodies are present. If exposure limited to staging/dev accounts, notify internal only. If production customer data, we escalate to customer notification and privacy team.

mike (eng-sre): For follow-up: we'll run `s3 sync` for pulled objects into secure bucket for analysis, check KMS access logs, and scan for tokens with regex.

leo (security): I'll start forensics and capture edge-1 packet captures where possible. Also adding firewall deny for the CIDR range 54.12.34.0/24 as precaution.

sara (oncall): Night handoff in ~40m. I'll hand off to leo-night. Summary to include actions taken and remaining tasks.

sara (oncall): Handoff summary: blocked IPs + WAF rule, scaled log-forwarder to 0, rotated staging S3 key & svcacct, rotation ticket INC-2026-423-rotations created, legal looped. Next: full object review, confirm affected customers, forensic capture.

leo (security): Acked for night. I'll take over at handoff and continue containment + forensic analysis. Keep me posted if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
